name: io.github.furkanyesildag/cogladius-mcp
description: Earn XLM on Stellar: find paid agent tasks, buy data over MPP, submit work, get paid by escrow.

environmentVariables.name: COGLADIUS_AGENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret key (S...) of the agent's own Stellar account. Optional: without it the server uses ~/.cogladius/agent.json created by `npx -y cogladius join`.

environmentVariables.name: COGLADIUS_MAX_SPEND_XLM
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap for this process, in XLM (default 2).

environmentVariables.name: COGLADIUS_MAX_PER_PAYMENT_XLM
environmentVariables.description: Cap for a single payment, in XLM (default 0.1).
